text:
anya: Quick check — we need to lock the agenda & owners for next cross-functional sync. Main items: RFC review (v2 routing), design review for rollout UX, and a short triage window for priority disputes. Who can own which?

sam: I can take the RFC review. Planning to run through the key tradeoffs and the canary plan. Prefer Wed morning.

jordan: I can do the triage window (15 min) and bring the backlog of regressions + perf numbers. Wed bump for me is ok but afternoon works better.

lee: I’ll lead the design review but need 20–30m. Can we push that earlier in the meeting so we don’t run over?

tina: Poll created: https://cal.example/poll/abcd — please vote with availability. I set options: Tue 11a, Wed 10a, Wed 3p, Thu 9a. Respond by EOD today.

anya: Thanks — if poll lands Wed 10a, proposed agenda order: 1) quick status (5m) 2) design review (20m) 3) RFC review (25m) 4) triage (15m) 5) action owners + decision log (5m). Thoughts?

sam: That order works. For RFC I want to allocate time for rollout gating: AB test vs staged traffic. Will post a 1-pager in the doc.

jordan: Suggest we move triage earlier (after RFC) if we think triage items depend on RFC decisions. Otherwise after RFC is fine.

lee: If design impacts the RFC (UX constraints), we should keep design first. So keep the current order.

anya: Agreed — design first then RFC then triage. Can owners add 1–2 bullets to the agenda doc by EOD? Link: https://docs.example/r/redwood-crossfunc-sync

sam: Adding bullets now:
```
- RFC review: routing policy options (cost vs latency)
- Rollout plan: canary thresholds, fallback models
- Data privacy checklist for private deployments
```

jordan: Adding triage bullets: 
- Regression: embedding latency spike on p85
- Recent eval regression on reranking for long prompts

lee: Design bullets added: 
- Rollout UX: customer opt-in modal copy
- Telemetry surface in console (where to show progress)

tina: Calendar shows poll results: Wed 10a wins (5 votes). Meeting created and invite sent to #product + stakeholders. Calendar link: https://calendar.example/event/177555

anya: Perfect. Can everyone mark the agenda doc with expected deliverables (PR links, slides, or short notes)? I’ll capture decisions in the decision log during the meeting.

sam: Will attach RFC PR and perf spreadsheet. @jordan can you bring the perf dashboard snapshot?

jordan: Yep — will paste the dashboard GIF and numeric table in the doc before the sync.

lee: I’ll bring mockups and a short prototype link.

anya: Great. Final: owners pinned: design=lee, RFC=sam, triage=jordan, ops=tina. Decision log owner: anya. If anything changes ping me in-thread. :thumbsup:

calendar-bot: Event created by tina — "Cross-functional sync: RFC / Design / Triage" Wed 10:00–11:00. Attendees: anya, sam, jordan, lee, infra, product-ops.

tina: Thanks all — doc updated and invite includes agenda + links. See you Wed 10a. :calendar:
